_note: Character voice providers (Milestone J). 'edge' = Microsoft Edge neural voices through the DEV service tools/voice/edge_service.py (port 12472, online, cached on disk); 'kokoro' = the local Kokoro-82M DEV service (port 12471, offline). Mika and Luna use the settings confirmed in Mika-Voice-Lab; their 'fallback' is used when the Edge service is unreachable or fails, and for lines spoken from fixed IPA (Latin incantations), which only Kokoro supports. Do not change the confirmed voices without the developer's approval.

phoenix._note: Oriel, the Phoenix (V3 Part X). CONFIRMED permanent voice: Google Gemini TTS 'Kore' (model gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts, GEMINI_API_KEY from .env, never printed). Same voice in both forms; the true form adds the VoicePhoenix bus resonance. Lines are cached forever (assets/voice/phoenix for shipped lines, user://voice_cache/gemini for new ones). The Kokoro fallback is a blend that is neither Mika's nor Luna's and is used only when the cloud voice is unavailable.

styles.humanoid: Read the following line aloud as Oriel, an ancient phoenix in the form of an elegant woman: warm, natural and unhurried, quietly amused when the words allow it. Speak only the line, nothing else.
styles.phoenix: Read the following line aloud as Oriel, an ancient phoenix: warm, natural and unhurried, with calm authority. Speak only the line, nothing else.

moods.serious: This moment is grave: speak with quiet command, slower, every word weighed.
moods.playful: She is amused and teasing a little, lightly.
moods.tender: She is gentle and fond, almost a whisper.

reactions._note: Laughter is never spoken as text ('hehe'). A leading/trailing laugh token in a line is removed and a short laugh clip in the SAME voice plays instead (rendered once per session through the Edge provider and cached by the service; see clips), with a happy expression. With no Edge voice available only the expression plays.

clips._note: Short laugh sounds rendered once per session in the speaker's own Edge voice (no words). Candidates - to be auditioned by the developer like the voices themselves.
